# seeded-push-ledger

The `PushLedger` provider (`tasks-core`'s host service) of a host without git —
the browser composition and the portable boot test. There is no `main` history
to project, so the `pushes` rows the database was seeded with ARE the ledger and
`ensureFresh()` has nothing to do. The desktop never boots it (`base-exclusions`,
`plugin-meta/composition`); `tasks-core#machine` re-derives the desktop's ledger
from git.

## Plugin reference

- Description: The push ledger of a host without git: provides the PushLedger host service as nothing to do — there is no main history to project, so the `pushes` rows the database was seeded with ARE the ledger (the browser composition, the portable boot test). Never booted by the desktop.
- Excluded: yes
- Server:
